o2c.notes: Fuel cracks 2.6-4.4x a year earlier (gasoline $35.4, gasoil $62.9, ATF $63.0/bbl); PE delta +46%, polyester chain +17%; weighed down by SAED/export duties, under-recoveries on domestic fuel sales and sales to PSUs, crude premiums up to ~$20/bbl, freight ~10x, planned CDU and coker turnaround (volumes -10%).

jio.note: ARPU +Rs7 YoY with no tariff increase in the last 12 months; finance cost +42% as 5G spectrum is capitalised.

retail.note: Gross revenue +7.4% (+11.6% adjusted for the consumer-brands demerger); EBITDA -1.1% on hyper-local delivery build-out; 3-year objective to double operating EBITDA through FY27-FY29 (no margin target).

jiostar.note: FY26 revenue Rs34,917 cr, net profit Rs3,434 cr (AGM).

q1fy27.newEnergy: ~1 GWp of HJT modules produced; scaling to 20 GWp module and 120 GWh battery capacity, 40 GWh battery to be commissioned this year; Kutch installation to start after the monsoon with power exports this year; US$3 bn green-ammonia contract with Samsung C&T.

guidance.text: Double absolute operating EBITDA over FY27-FY29; FY27 a foundation year (scale online), FY28-29 value conversion.
Net debt to EBITDA below 1x through cycles; capex within operating cash flow (Q1FY27 capex Rs38,682 cr); no specific capex guidance.

DRHP filed 19-Jun-2026 for a fresh issue of up to 27 cr shares (no OFS; up to Rs27,500 cr to repay RJIL debt); SEBI observations received 28-Aug-2026; price band and dates not announced by 30-Sep-2026 (media: issue ~Rs37,700 cr, valuation ~US$130-137 bn).
Battery 40 GWh this year; modules to 20 GWp; Kutch power this year; AGM: electrolyser manufacturing before end-CY2026; Antique expects commissioning from Jan-2027.
Chairman at AGM 2026: EBITDA could double over the next five years; exports target US$125-150 bn by 2032.

history: Jio Platforms sells about a third of itself to Meta, Google and global funds; RIL rights issue
Reliance Retail sells 10.09% for Rs47,265 cr
O2C carved out as a segment; New Energy plan (Rs75,000 cr over three years) announced
Jio Financial Services demerged (1 share per RIL share, Jul-2023); QIA (~0.99% for Rs8,278 cr) and KKR (follow-on) invest in RRVL
1:1 bonus (Oct-2024); Viacom18-Star India merger creates JioStar (Nov-2024)
Asian Paints stake sold (Rs8,924 cr gain, Q1FY26); US sanctions on Rosneft/Lukoil (Oct-2025); consumer brands demerged from RRVL to RCPL (1-Dec-2025)
US-Iran war from 28-Feb-2026 and Hormuz disruption; export duties/SAED on diesel and ATF from 26-Mar-2026; Jio DRHP (19-Jun), SEBI nod (28-Aug)

accounting: JDFPL preference shares Rs98,881 cr (consolidated) at fair value through OCI: Level 3, a key audit matter (fibre-asset cash flows).
Deferred spectrum payment liabilities Rs1,04,514 cr sit outside 'borrowings' and outside the company's net-debt figure (Rs1,24,717 cr).
Large CWIP and intangibles under development (Rs2.38 lakh cr at Mar-26 incl. spectrum under development Rs8,611 cr): interest and depreciation step up as assets are capitalised (5G in FY26-27).
Segment EBITDA includes other income attributed to segments; treasury income sits in 'Others'.
